title: Achievement bank entry
description: One atomic, guardrailed unit of evidence in the master achievement bank. The bank is the single source of truth; every resume, bullet, and interview story is a lossy PROJECTION of a selection from it. Entries are outcome-aware: each accumulates a track record of which framings, for which role archetypes, led to callbacks.

id.description: Stable slug, e.g. 'aimx-0-to-1'. Referenced by applications and framings.

title.description: Short human label for the achievement.

raw_evidence.description: The LOSSLESS narrative of what happened — including detail that never reaches a resume. This is the truth every projection is checked against.

metrics.description: Quantified outcomes. Kept separate from prose so a projection can cite them precisely and the eval gate can verify no number is invented.

basis.description: How it was measured / where it comes from.

scope.description: The role and ownership context, so a projection can never imply seniority or scope not held.

guardrails.description: What must NOT be claimed from this entry. First-class data so the eval gate can enforce it, e.g. 'eight-figure, not the internal $ estimate', 'engineer in cloud, PM in identity', 'not fully automated'.

visibility.description: private = contains customer names, internal figures, unreleased dates; never rendered to a public artifact.

framings.description: Approved reframes of this achievement per target role-archetype. The library the renderer chooses from; outcomes attach to these.

framing_id.description: Stable id within this entry, e.g. 'security-forward'.

archetype.description: Role archetype this framing targets, e.g. 'cloud-security', 'ai-native'.

outcomes.description: THE LOOP LIVES HERE. Attribution of real-world results down to the evidence + framing level: which framing of this achievement, for which archetype, was in play when a result landed. Sparse and noisy by design — treat as logged signal, never as proof, until a pattern repeats (see track/LOOP.md).

application_id.description: Ref to an entry in the applications log.

framing_id.description: Which framing of this entry was surfaced.
